leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply flex shorthand properties to configure container behavior in one declaration
Construct responsive layouts using flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis patterns
Implement flex-direction and flex-wrap combinations for different content flows
Manipulate flex item alignment using justify-content and align-items shorthand patterns
Configure complex flex containers by combining multiple shorthand properties
Update existing layouts by replacing verbose flex properties with shorthand equivalents
Integrate flex shorthand with other CSS properties to create cohesive designs
